challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The current evaluation process is entirely manual, and I am willing to accept that constraint. I will give up the ability to rapidly iterate on new weather features and test multiple configurations in a single afternoon. In exchange, I accept that every test case must be rigorously documented before any model change is considered. This means I will lose the speed of automated feedback loops, but I am comfortable trading that velocity for the certainty that our validation steps are fully traceable and meet the documentation standards required for the next deployment cycle.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up rapid iteration speed in exchange for rigorous documentation and traceability, which defines a clear trade-off between velocity and compliance.
